rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken way to describe something related to a genome.

example.traditional: 呢份報告係同基因組有關嘅。
example.jyutping: ne1 fan6 bou3 gou3 hai6 tung4 gei1 jan1 zou2 jau5 gwaan1 ge3

rows.note: Use this compact noun modifier inside technical compounds such as genomic data, rather than as a standalone predicate.

example.english: The genomic data hasn’t been organized yet.
example.traditional: 基因組數據仲未整理好。
example.jyutping: gei1 jan1 zou2 sou3 geoi3 zung6 mei6 zing2 lei5 hou2
